description:
Hello, I'm Trevor, a retired Air Force veteran, dad, husband, and electronics technician. I founded Electrical You to empower individuals to safely tackle their own small electrical projects when it's appropriate and safe to do so. I also review as many electrical tools and gadgets as I can along the way so you can make an informed decision before buying the tools you need to get the job done.

My goal is to provide clear, concise, and safe electrical how-to tutorials that anyone can easily follow. I aim to help the everyday DIYer save time and money by learning how to perform their own electrical troubleshooting and repairs at home, without the need to hire expensive electricians for tasks they can handle themselves.

Disclaimer: Electrical work can be dangerous. Always prioritize safety and consult with a qualified electrician for any complex, code-mandated, or high-voltage situations.
